audit_only_adaptation.RED: Construct counterexamples that should be blocked and verify whether published learner code/gates accept them.
audit_only_adaptation.GREEN: Do not patch curriculum. State the minimal repair as proposed diff/improved text.
audit_only_adaptation.VALIDATE: Use an independent verifier pass across shared UI, roadmap, capstone, exam, figures and live surface.
audit_only_adaptation.MEMORY: Persist append-only section shards, a full-scope index and a quick-reference wiki.
audit_only_adaptation.convergence: After the last new material finding, require two independent rescans with no additional P0/P1 before closing. P2 findings still recorded.

reader_model: Capable learner entering S44 with only prior PyArcana knowledge; no hidden DevOps background. Technical terms must be introduced causally and real evidence must not be replaced by author/learner assertions.
critical_evidence_rule: A learner-editable boolean/string may summarize evidence but is never itself sufficient proof that a CI, supply-chain, approval, attestation, canary or rollback control occurred.

pre_round_research.finding_basis: Full-length action commit SHA is the immutable pinning form; verify the SHA belongs to the intended action repository.
Generation needs `attestations: write`, `id-token: write`, `contents: read`; verification is a cryptographic/identity operation, not a boolean flag.
Required reviewers, prevent self-review, deployment branch restrictions and optional no-bypass protection are enforceable controls.
Dependency review is computed from PR dependency changes and can be required to block vulnerable additions; a local `dependency_review=True` is not equivalent evidence.
Provenance is verifiable information tracking an artifact to where/when/how it was produced.

rounds.name: red_counterexample_pass

runtime_counterexamples.expected: Reject malformed SHA-256 digest; prefix alone is not proof.

runtime_counterexamples.case: workflow has an unpinned third-party action followed by a 40-hex pinned action
runtime_counterexamples.observed: final `pin_ok=True` because the variable is overwritten per step
runtime_counterexamples.expected: Any unpinned action must fail the gate; all `uses:` entries must pass.

runtime_counterexamples.case: artifact, SBOM and provenance strings are all `sha256:aaa`
runtime_counterexamples.expected: Validate digest syntax, subject relationship and attestation identity/cryptography; SBOM document hash is not artifact subject hash.
Reject negative/out-of-domain metrics before comparing thresholds.

runtime_counterexamples.case: all required keys exist but every value is empty
runtime_counterexamples.expected: Require non-empty actionable content and validate required semantics.

runtime_counterexamples.case: healthy run with no critical failure
runtime_counterexamples.expected: Healthy path should continue/pass; incident handling should only activate on an actual critical failure or missing critical evidence.

runtime_counterexamples.case: set all four learner-editable evidence flags True without inspecting artifacts
runtime_counterexamples.expected: Derive readiness from workflow/artifact/SBOM/provenance/canary/rollback evidence, not flags.

rounds.result: Confirmed exploitable false-greens and one false-red/invalid healthy state.
